name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Lets two parties share confidential information with each other, for example while evaluating a business relationship, and sets how it must be protected.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: For selling or buying a cloud service or SaaS product: access and use, payment, privacy and security, warranties, liability and term.

terms.label: Cloud Service
terms.hint: The cloud service or SaaS product the Customer is subscribing to.

terms.label: Order Date
terms.hint: When the first order starts, e.g. the Effective Date.

terms.label: Subscription Period
terms.hint: How long each subscription term lasts, e.g. 1 year from the Order Date.

terms.label: Fees
terms.hint: Subscription fees and how they are billed, e.g. $2,000 per month, billed annually in advance.

terms.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
terms.hint: Deadline for giving notice of non-renewal, e.g. 30 days before the end of the current Subscription Period.

terms.label: Technical Support
terms.hint: The support the Provider gives, e.g. email support during business hours.

terms.label: General Cap Amount
terms.hint: Each party's maximum total liability, e.g. the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim.

terms.label: Provider Covered Claims
terms.hint: Third-party claims the Provider defends the Customer against, e.g. claims that the Cloud Service infringes someone's intellectual property.

terms.label: Customer Covered Claims
terms.hint: Third-party claims the Customer defends the Provider against, e.g. claims that Customer Content infringes someone's intellectual property.

terms.label: DPA
terms.hint: The parties' data processing agreement, if any.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Used alongside a Cloud Service Agreement to set target uptime and support response times, and the service credits when they are missed.

terms.label: Agreement
terms.hint: The cloud service agreement this SLA supplements, e.g. the Cloud Service Agreement between the parties dated January 5, 2027.

terms.label: Target Uptime
terms.hint: Availability the Provider aims for each calendar month, e.g. 99.9%.

terms.label: Scheduled Downtime
terms.hint: Planned maintenance that doesn't count against uptime, e.g. up to 4 hours a month with 48 hours' notice.

terms.label: Uptime Credit
terms.hint: Credit when uptime falls below target, e.g. 10% of that month's fees.

terms.label: Target Response Time
terms.hint: How quickly the Provider responds to support requests, e.g. 4 business hours.

terms.label: Support Channel
terms.hint: Where support requests are sent, e.g. support@example.com.

terms.label: Response Time Credit
terms.hint: Credit when a response is late, e.g. 5% of that month's fees.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Sets out how a provider processes a customer's personal data, including security, subprocessors, data subject requests, security incidents and international transfers (GDPR, UK and Swiss requirements).

terms.label: Agreement
terms.hint: The main agreement under which the Provider processes the Customer's personal data, e.g. the Cloud Service Agreement between the parties dated January 5, 2027.

terms.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
terms.hint: What the Provider does with the personal data and why, e.g. hosting and processing data to provide the Cloud Service.

terms.label: Categories of Data Subjects
terms.hint: Whose data is processed, e.g. the Customer's employees and end users.

terms.label: Categories of Personal Data
terms.hint: What kinds of personal data, e.g. names, email addresses and usage data.

terms.label: Special Category Data
terms.hint: Any sensitive data such as health or biometric data.

terms.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
terms.hint: Extra safeguards for any special category data.

terms.label: Frequency of Transfer
terms.hint: How often personal data is transferred, e.g. continuously.

terms.label: Duration of Processing
terms.hint: How long processing lasts, e.g. for the term of the Agreement.
terms.default: For the term of the Agreement

terms.label: Approved Subprocessors
terms.hint: The subprocessors the Customer approves, or a link to the Provider's list.

terms.label: Governing Member State
terms.hint: The EU member state whose law governs the EU Standard Contractual Clauses, e.g. Ireland.

terms.label: Security Policy
terms.hint: The security standard the Provider is audited against, e.g. SOC 2 Type II.

terms.label: Provider Security Contact
terms.hint: Where security requests go, e.g. security@example.com.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Gives an early user access to a product in exchange for feedback and taking part in a design partner program.

terms.label: Product
terms.hint: The product the Partner gets early access to.

terms.label: Program
terms.hint: What the design partner program involves, e.g. monthly feedback calls and testing new features.

terms.label: Term
terms.hint: How long the agreement lasts, e.g. 6 months from the Effective Date.

terms.label: Fees
terms.hint: What the Partner pays, if anything.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: For hiring a provider to perform services and produce deliverables under statements of work (SOWs), covering payment, IP ownership, warranties, liability and termination.

terms.label: Deliverables
terms.hint: The services and deliverables in the first SOW.

terms.label: SOW Term
terms.hint: When the first SOW starts and ends, e.g. February 1 to July 31, 2027.

terms.label: Fees
terms.hint: What the Customer pays for the SOW, e.g. $15,000 per month.

terms.label: Payment Period
terms.hint: Time to pay each invoice, e.g. 30 days from receipt.

terms.label: Rejection Period
terms.hint: Time the Customer has to reject a Deliverable, e.g. 10 business days.

terms.label: Resubmission Period
terms.hint: Time the Provider has to fix and resubmit a rejected Deliverable, e.g. 10 business days.

terms.label: Time of Assignment
terms.hint: When ownership of Deliverables passes to the Customer, e.g. on payment of the related Fees.

terms.label: Customer Obligations
terms.hint: What the Customer must provide, e.g. timely access to staff and systems.

terms.label: Customer Policies
terms.hint: Customer policies the Provider must follow, if any.

terms.label: General Cap Amount
terms.hint: Each party's maximum total liability, e.g. the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim.

terms.label: Increased Cap Amount
terms.hint: A higher cap for Increased Claims, if any.

terms.label: Increased Claims
terms.hint: Claims subject to the Increased Cap Amount, if any.

terms.label: Unlimited Claims
terms.hint: Claims with no liability cap, if any.

terms.label: Provider Covered Claims
terms.hint: Third-party claims the Provider defends the Customer against, e.g. claims that the Deliverables infringe someone's intellectual property.

terms.label: Customer Covered Claims
terms.hint: Third-party claims the Customer defends the Provider against, e.g. claims arising from materials the Customer provides.

terms.label: Additional Warranties
terms.hint: Any warranties beyond the standard ones.

terms.label: Insurance Minimums
terms.hint: Insurance each party must carry, if any.

terms.label: Security Policy
terms.hint: Security requirements the Provider must follow, if any.

terms.label: DPA
terms.hint: The parties' data processing agreement, if any.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: For a business partnership between two companies: each party's obligations, fees, trademark licensing, confidentiality, liability and indemnification.

terms.label: Obligations
terms.hint: What each party will do, e.g. the Partner refers customers and the Company provides sales training.

terms.label: Territory
terms.hint: Where the partnership applies, e.g. the United States.

terms.label: End Date
terms.hint: When the agreement ends, e.g. 2 years after the Effective Date.

terms.label: Fees
terms.hint: Fees either party pays the other, e.g. a 20% referral fee on first-year revenue.

terms.label: Payment Process
terms.hint: How fees are billed, e.g. invoiced monthly.

terms.label: Payment Schedule
terms.hint: When fees are paid, e.g. within 30 days of the invoice.

terms.label: Brand Guidelines
terms.hint: Rules for using each other's brand, if any.

terms.label: General Cap Amount
terms.hint: Each party's maximum total liability, e.g. $100,000.

terms.label: Increased Cap Amount
terms.hint: A higher cap for Increased Claims, if any.

terms.label: Increased Claims
terms.hint: Claims subject to the Increased Cap Amount, if any.

terms.label: Unlimited Claims
terms.hint: Claims with no liability cap, if any.

terms.label: Company Covered Claims
terms.hint: Third-party claims the Company defends the Partner against.

terms.label: Partner Covered Claims
terms.hint: Third-party claims the Partner defends the Company against.

terms.label: Additional Warranties
terms.hint: Any warranties beyond the standard ones.

terms.label: DPA
terms.hint: The parties' data processing agreement, if any.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Sets out HIPAA obligations for a provider that creates, receives, maintains or transmits protected health information (PHI) for a covered entity.

terms.label: Agreement
terms.hint: The underlying agreement under which the Provider handles PHI, e.g. the Cloud Service Agreement between the parties dated January 5, 2027.

terms.label: Breach Notification Period
terms.hint: How soon the Provider must report a breach, e.g. 5 business days after discovery.

terms.label: Limitations
terms.hint: Limits on how the Provider may use or disclose PHI, e.g. no offshore subcontractors.

name: Software License Agreement
description: For licensing software that the customer installs on systems it owns or controls: license grant, restrictions, support, payment, warranties, liability and indemnification.

terms.label: Software
terms.hint: The software being licensed.

terms.label: Order Date
terms.hint: When the first order starts, e.g. the Effective Date.

terms.label: Subscription Period
terms.hint: How long each license term lasts, e.g. 1 year from the Order Date.

terms.label: Permitted Uses
terms.hint: What the Customer may use the Software for, e.g. its internal business purposes.

terms.label: License Limits
terms.hint: Usage limits, e.g. up to 50 named users.

terms.label: Fees
terms.hint: License fees, e.g. $30,000 per year.

terms.label: Payment Process
terms.hint: How fees are paid, e.g. invoiced annually, payable within 30 days.

terms.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
terms.hint: Deadline for giving notice of non-renewal, e.g. 30 days before the end of the current Subscription Period.

terms.label: Warranty Period
terms.hint: How long the Software is warranted to work as documented, e.g. 90 days from delivery.

terms.label: Deletion Procedure
terms.hint: How the Customer removes the Software when the agreement ends, e.g. uninstall it and certify deletion within 30 days.

terms.label: General Cap Amount
terms.hint: Each party's maximum total liability, e.g. the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim.

terms.label: Increased Cap Amount
terms.hint: A higher cap for Increased Claims, if any.

terms.label: Increased Claims
terms.hint: Claims subject to the Increased Cap Amount, if any.

terms.label: Unlimited Claims
terms.hint: Claims with no liability cap, if any.

terms.label: Provider Covered Claims
terms.hint: Third-party claims the Provider defends the Customer against, e.g. claims that the Software infringes someone's intellectual property.

terms.label: Customer Covered Claims
terms.hint: Third-party claims the Customer defends the Provider against.

terms.label: Additional Warranties
terms.hint: Any warranties beyond the standard ones.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: For a short trial or evaluation that lets a prospective customer test a product before committing to a full commercial agreement.

terms.label: Product
terms.hint: The product being piloted.

terms.label: Pilot Period
terms.hint: How long the pilot lasts, e.g. 60 days from the Effective Date.

terms.label: General Cap Amount
terms.hint: Each party's maximum total liability, e.g. $10,000.

name: AI Addendum
description: Adds terms for AI services to a commercial agreement: ownership and use of inputs and outputs, limits on training models with customer data, and AI-specific disclaimers.

terms.label: Agreement
terms.hint: The commercial agreement this addendum supplements, e.g. the Cloud Service Agreement between the parties dated January 5, 2027.

terms.label: Training Data
terms.hint: Customer data the Provider may use to train models. None means no training is allowed.

terms.label: Training Purposes
terms.hint: What models may be trained for, if training is allowed.

terms.label: Training Restrictions
terms.hint: Limits on training, e.g. data must be de-identified first.

terms.label: Improvement Restrictions
terms.hint: Limits on using inputs and outputs to improve the service without training.
